    Journal Articles

    Global burden of enteric infectious diseases, diarrhoeal diseases, and corresponding aetiologies, 1990–2023: a systematic analysis for the GBD Study 2023

    Published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases (Impact Factor: 29.4), 2026

    A comprehensive systematic global burden analysis across 1990–2023 as part of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023, published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases.

    Recommended citation: GBD 2023 Diarrhoeal Disease Collaborators (incl. Md. Mehedi Hassan). (2026). "Global burden of enteric infectious diseases, diarrhoeal diseases, and corresponding aetiologies, 1990–2023: a systematic analysis for the GBD Study 2023." The Lancet Infectious Diseases — Elsevier.

    Resource constraint crop damage classification using depth channel shuffling

    Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (Impact Factor: 8.0), 2025

    Lead and corresponding author research on resource-constrained deep learning architectures for agricultural computer vision and image classification.

    Recommended citation: Islam, Md Tanvir, et al. & Hassan, Md. Mehedi (Lead & Corresponding Author †). (2025). "Resource constraint crop damage classification using depth channel shuffling." Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, Elsevier, Vol. 144: 110117.

    FedVGM: Enhancing Federated Learning Performance on Multi-Dataset Medical Images with XAI

    Published in IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (Impact Factor: 6.8), 2025

    Corresponding author work proposing FedVGM, a federated learning framework integrated with explainable AI (XAI) for heterogeneous medical image datasets.

    Recommended citation: Tahosin, Mst Sazia, et al. & Hassan, Md. Mehedi (Corresponding Author †). (2025). "FedVGM: Enhancing Federated Learning Performance on Multi-Dataset Medical Images with XAI." IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics, IEEE.

    NeuroNet19: an explainable deep neural network model for the classification of brain tumors using magnetic resonance imaging data

    Published in Scientific Reports — Nature Portfolio (Impact Factor: 3.9), 2024

    Lead and corresponding author study introducing NeuroNet19, an explainable deep neural network architecture for MRI brain tumor classification published in Scientific Reports (Nature Portfolio).

    Recommended citation: Haque, Rezuana, Hassan, Md. Mehedi, Anupam Kumar Bairagi, Sheikh Mohammed Shariful Islam (Lead & Corresponding Author †). (2024). "NeuroNet19: an explainable deep neural network model for the classification of brain tumors using magnetic resonance imaging data." Scientific Reports, Nature Portfolio, Vol. 14: 1524.

    Efficient prediction of coronary artery disease using machine learning algorithms with feature selection techniques

    Published in Computers and Electrical Engineering (Impact Factor: 4.9), 2024

    First and corresponding author research on machine learning diagnostic pipelines and optimal feature selection for coronary artery disease.

    Recommended citation: Hassan, Md. Mehedi, Sadika Zaman, Md Mushfiqur Rahman, et al. (First & Corresponding Author †). (2024). "Efficient prediction of coronary artery disease using machine learning algorithms with feature selection techniques." Computers and Electrical Engineering, Elsevier, Vol. 115: 109130.

    Machine learning-based rainfall prediction: Unveiling insights and forecasting for improved preparedness

    Published in IEEE Access (Impact Factor: 3.6), 2023

    First and corresponding author research on predictive machine learning models and spatial forecasting for hydro-meteorological preparedness.

    Recommended citation: Hassan, Md. Mehedi, Mohammad Abu Tareq Rony, Md Asif Rakib Khan, et al. (First & Corresponding Author †). (2023). "Machine learning-based rainfall prediction: Unveiling insights and forecasting for improved preparedness." IEEE Access, IEEE, Vol. 11: 132196–132222.
